paper_id: User Intention Recognition and Requirement Elicitation Method for Conversational AI Services
title: User Intention Recognition and Requirement Elicitation Method for Conversational AI Services
motivation: chat-bot服务常与用户期望不符，因用户表达不完整不确定与服务资源多样性，需用多轮对话引导但轮数过多体验差
problem_framing: 将用户模糊需求识别转化为知识图谱实体推理，用粒计算实现对话策略自动生成以减少轮数
key_insight: 粒计算能自动划分连续变量模糊边界，无需人工预设阈值，且能多维聚合服务而非逐属性询问
method_signature: KG推理+GrC聚类剪枝实现多轮对话策略，替代预设规则和逐属性slot填充
evaluation_criteria: Hit rate和平均对话轮数，优先减少轮数而非单一指标最优
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 多跳文本需求无法清晰识别，剪枝策略仍需离线预处理，希望未来在线实时
evidence_for_taste: the services it provides are not what users expect
a 36.1% decreasing in the average rounds
GrC method solves the problem of the fuzzy boundary
Artificial can define more than a particular value means expensive
We believe that a 36.1% decreasing would make the conversational AI bot user experience better
thinking_moves: 把对话策略生成从在线计算转为离线预计算，用GrC结果树引导实时询问
用多维聚合代替单属性递进询问，减少对话轮数而不降低语义理解能力
接受1%准确率损失换取36%轮数减少，explicitly prioritize用户体验 over单一指标
从工程异常(模糊价格描述)反推连续变量边界需自动划分而非人工阈值
cites_own_work: E-sbot: A soft service robot for user-centric smart service delivery (2019)
Crowdsourcing service requirement oriented requirement pattern elicitation method (2019)
